PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 1927/21 – TUESDAY, AUGUST 11, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (Chapter 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: MCUDP/LA/St. Seb. North (W-09)/14/01.
Land Min.’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2013/LRB/524.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to be utilized for the renovation activities and construction of access road for the use of canal bank maintenance of St. Sebastian (North) Canal and construction of a pump house under the Metro Colombo Urban Development Project.

Description of the land to be acquired: Allotments of land in total extent of 1.0529 Hectares depicted as Lot No. 01 to No. 148 in the Preliminary Plan No. Co. 9557 dated 09.07.2015 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village called Sedawatta, Weragoda in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 509A of Sedawatta, Mahawatta in the Divisional Secretary’s Divisions of Colombo and Kolonnawa in Colombo District of Western Province and described as follows:-
Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Could not be traced; Present Land use: Home Garden, part of an abandoned permanent building; Claimant: State; Encroacher: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0023 Hectare.
